contract.review_scope: Full retained body read, authored input/output/effect/branch/configuration/error/transaction/concurrency explanations; source current per owner.
contract.purpose: Drill location charts to template-field values within a zone and location type.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration; placeholders are not executable argument values: CREATE Procedure INV_MonitorTemplateFieldChartData @filterCriteria nVarchar(MAX), @culture nvarchar(10) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: NULL zone/type selects only NULL values, not wildcards. Empty COUNT returns 0. Percentage zero branch uses an opaque string converted to FLOAT; do not infer its spelling.
output_shape: Five result sets; chart NextDrillDownLevel=-1 and DATA descending; tiles TOTAL_LOCATIONS/EMPTY_LOCATIONS/PERCENT_EMPTY/FROZEN_EMPTY.

ordered_branches.explanation: Parse warehouse/zone/type and translate coded sentinels to NULL. Group active coded-status rows by TEMPLATE_FIELD1, with exact-or-both-NULL zone/type filters.

Count distinct locations for total and empty separately, calculate percentage, and count frozen-empty locations using the same outer filters but a global inventory location-name exclusion. Return four tiles after the chart.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: Read-only terminal drilldown; no configuration or inventory writes.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: culture localizes the NULL template-field category. Inner NOT IN inventory exclusion has no warehouse restriction.
error_and_return_handling: Final @@ERROR/GOTO only; no general TRY/CATCH. Normal path returns 0 and NOCOUNT OFF.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoint or SET XACT_ABORT in this body. Caller/session transaction behavior governs partial completion; this contract does not assume atomic child calls.
concurrency: Independent chart/tile queries can differ under concurrent changes.
contract.trigger_behavior: No direct persistent DML; called routines retain their own trigger and effect contracts.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Application callers, current record state and active permissions were not observed. No extension, assembly or Azure-function changes are required by this documentation task.
Explicit child/function calls are listed; their exact source contracts bound transitive effects. Opaque selectors are retained as technical evidence, without fabricated labels.
